definitions.analysis_window: Main-probe elapsed_seconds >= 0.5; all main probes requested5s. No alignment or extrapolation between runs.
definitions.actual_yaw: Sum wrapped adjacent capsule-yaw differences; absolute travel additionally counts reversals. Main full-window and cropped-window results are separate.
definitions.root_gap: wrap(CharacterTransform.yaw - RootTransform.yaw), not final chest/shield facing.
definitions.negative_foot: foot_geometry.signed_feet_lateral_cm < 0 along measured thigh_l-to-thigh_r hip axis; projected anatomical side reversal, not proof of surface intersection.
definitions.negative_duration: Left-held value over each actual adjacent world-time interval wholly in the analysis window; last sample has no extrapolated duration.
definitions.alpha_gate: needs_leg_motion_flips counts Boolean changes; alpha_half_crossings counts crossings of0.5 for descriptive reporting only.
definitions.settle_zero: First sampled Alpha <=1e-6 relative to the separately started settle probe, not latency from input release. Probe request was1.2s for these seven captures.
definitions.selection: Snapshot property read models only: Mover LocomotionSetup1 StateMachine, CMC0 MotionMatching. Neither proves all blend-stack contributors or selected source phase.
